authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI artifacts that compromise physical realism. Several cookies appear fused into the canvas fabric of the backpack rather than resting on it (e.g., the cookie on the far left and those on the right side lack proper contact shadows and seem to melt into the bag). The geometry of the backpack warps unnaturally around the cookies, particularly on the left side where the bag's edge distorts. While the texture of the canvas and cookies is high quality individually, their physical interaction is flawed. The topology auditor reported high mask confidence (0.99), but this only indicates coherent segmentation, not correct physics; the fusion artifacts are semantic/physical errors that the mask cannot detect.
key_defects: Cookie count mismatch (9 visible vs 7 expected)
Fusion artifacts between cookies and backpack surface
Structural warping of backpack geometry around cookies
Lack of realistic contact shadows for several cookies
